mount-opacity.horse-opacity.description: Changes the opacity of the horse you are currently riding.
mount-opacity.pig-opacity.description: Changes the opacity of the pig you are currently riding.
mount-opacity.llama-opacity.description: Changes the opacity of the llama you are currently riding.
mount-opacity.strider-opacity.descriptio: Changes the opacity of the strider you are currently riding.
mount-opacity.camel-opacity.description: Changes the opacity of the camel you are currently riding.
mount-opacity.nautilus-opacity.descripti: Changes the opacity of the nautilus you are currently riding.
mount-opacity.happy-ghast-opacity.descri: Changes the opacity of the happy ghast you are currently riding.
mount-opacity.default-opacity.descriptio: Changes the opacity of every other entity you are currently riding. This allows for setting opacity on modded mounts or any mounts that may have been forgotten.
mount-opacity.only-in-first-person.descr: Only set custom opacities when in first person view.
mount-opacity.use-look-direction.descrip: Uses your look direction and your opacity values to determine mount opacity. The lower you look, the more translucent the entity gets.
mount-opacity.look-offset.description: This decides when to start applying translucency. If at 0, it will only begin applying after looking down from 0 degrees (straight ahead).
mount-opacity.look-range.description: This decides the range needed to look down before reaching the minimum translucency (the entity's opacity config value).
